subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` as a public core config surface now, and should Lossless `summaryModel` fallback live in the Lossless plugin or in a generic context-engine SDK contract?
rationale: The remaining work adds provider/auth routing behavior and crosses core compaction plus plugin-owned Lossless/context-engine boundaries, so automation should not choose the product/API contract alone.

options.title: Approve Core Compaction, Plugin-Owned Lossless
options.body: Add an explicit embedded-compaction fallback chain in core and keep Lossless summary-model fallback in the Lossless plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

options.title: Design One Context-Engine Fallback Contract
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose a unified API for embedded compaction, Lossless, and future context-engine summaries.

options.title: Keep Fallbacks Outside Core
options.body: Decline a new core config key and ask operators to use provider plugins, compaction providers, or external routing for summarizer fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Compaction, Plugin-Owned Lossless
recommendation.body: Add an explicit embedded-compaction fallback chain in core and keep Lossless summary-model fallback in the Lossless plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Their context-engine compaction delegate and compaction fallback history best match the core/plugin ownership decision.
